subject: Intro + quick feasibility Qs before demo — Olive Systems
messages:
From: Anna Rios <anna.rios@olivesys.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in Redwood Inference — evaluation + demo

Hi Marcus,

We signed up for the self-serve trial this morning and started running a couple of small workloads against the hosted API. Olive Systems is exploring using Redwood to power real-time product personalization (short-form generation + reranking) and also a batch embedding pipeline for nightly recommendations.

Before I book a demo, would appreciate a quick sanity check: can Redwood support mixed realtime and batch workflows (low-latency generation for user-facing calls + high-throughput embedding batches) from the same account? Also: any docs on expected token-cost for mixed workloads?

A bit about us: 120M monthly active users (edge traffic spikes), experimenting with a 500k record nightly embedding job, and real-time calls averaging 100–250 QPS during peak product events. Our timeline is aggressive: pilot in Q4 2026, production in Q1 2027.

If you think a short demo is useful, I can share a sample dataset and a few example prompts.

Thanks,
Anna Rios
Product Lead, Olive Systems
anna.rios@olivesys.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Rios <anna.rios@olivesys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood Inference — evaluation + demo

Hi Anna — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. I'm Marcus on the SDR/solutions side; Marissa (cc'd) is the AE who usually runs pilots like yours.

Short answers up front: yes, our platform is designed for mixed realtime and batch workloads from the same account; we support dedicated pools + hosted routing and automatic batching for cost efficiency. Token cost depends a lot on model family and sequence length.

A couple quick qual Qs so we make the demo productive:
- Is the 500k nightly job latency-sensitive or can it run in a lower-priority batch tier?
- What model capabilities are you prioritizing for realtime (pure generation, few-shot personalization, reranking with embeddings)?
- Do you have any hard PII/regulatory constraints for the data sent to hosted endpoints?
- What are the top success metrics for the pilot (latency p90, cost per 1k tokens, accuracy/CTR uplift)?

If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute technical demo with Marissa and our solutions engineer to walk architecture and cost profiles. Suggesting two time windows (PST):
- Thu 2026-09-16 10:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-09-16 15:00–15:30

If those don't work, propose some times and we can adjust. Also, feel free to attach the sample dataset — I'm happy to take a look ahead of the call.

Best,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

On a related note: attaching a one-pager agenda for demos so you know what to expect. (Attachment: demo_agenda.pdf)
From: Anna Rios <anna.rios@olivesys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Byrne <cto@olivesys.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood Inference — evaluation + demo

Thanks Marcus — useful summary. Quick answers below and attaching a small sample (anonymized) of the records we plan to embed.

- Nightly job: not latency-sensitive, can run in lower-priority batch; budget is a concern but we expect high throughput.
- Realtime priorities: short-form generation for CTAs + reranking candidate list using embeddings. Reranking needs sub-200ms p90 ideally.
- Data sensitivity: minimal PII in the sample; production will include user ids and content snippets, so we'd like to understand retention and KMS options.
- Success metrics: p90 latency <= 200ms for realtime, embedding throughput of ~500k records/night under $X per 1k tokens (we'll discuss target ranges on the call), and a measurable CTR uplift vs current baseline.

Attached: example_data_sample.csv (1000 anonymized rows) and a short SOW outline we use for pilots (sow_outline.docx).

Any chance to add Marissa's team to the demo? She'll want to discuss commercial terms and pilot SLAs.

— Anna

- Thu 2026-09-23 10:00–10:45 (preferred: gives us time to prep environment)
